meta.title: Flagged for review — Verify Hub (cross-lab)
meta.policy: Every value cell is blank. Nothing flagged here blocks publication; each row is published so a reviewer can decide. Rows marked 'carried' were first flagged by a prior session and remain open.

rows.item: Historical player-prop closing prices (any market, any season)
rows.reason: No official or feed source publishes historical prop prices; every prop ROI in the repository is therefore blank by policy (C-01).
rows.action: Acquire a licensed historical odds feed (Q-05) or run a forward-only price log; until then prop strategies stay paper.

rows.reason: No opening-line archive exists in the committed data or any official source (C-02).
Nothing in the repository verifies an account, an executable price, a limit or a licence (C-03).
rows.action: Verify jurisdiction and operator before any capital decision (Q-09); gates G8/G9 stay open until then.

rows.reason: All four published reward schedules are unfunded paper (C-04). The NFL Big Data Bowl 2027 prize structure is a precedent, not funding for this project.
rows.action: Owner decision on funding (Q-10); until then label every schedule 'paper points' (SG-04).

rows.item: League-published depth strings (1st-4th) for offense and defense
rows.reason: NFL.com club depth-chart path returns 404 (VH-SRC-03, checked 2026-11-12); the official injury report has no depth column (C-05).
rows.action: Adopt the inferred usage-tier design with explicit labels and keep official cells blank (Q-08, SG-02).

rows.item: NFL Operations injury-report policy page (cited as a register source)
rows.reason: The URL returns 404 on 2026-11-12 (VH-SRC-05); first flagged 2026-11-01 by the root session and still dead (C-06, I-01).
rows.action: Mark the register entry dead with retrieval dates, or replace with a serving official copy (SG-07).

rows.item: QB-WR1 correlation coefficient quoted without a definition label
rows.reason: Four different coefficients (0.562 / 0.631 / 0.614 / 0.372) are published across labs for differently defined series; bare quotes create false contradictions (I-02).
rows.action: Every quote carries definition + window + n + as-of date (SG-06, SG-08).

rows.item: STR-16 integrity control (+64.81% ROI, 8/10 gates) is a leakage detector, not a strategy
rows.reason: A reader could mistake the deliberate-leak control for performance (I-03).
rows.action: Keep the DISQUALIFIED label adjacent to every STR-16 number; never sort it into a performance table.

rows.item: Eight parallel hubs implement overlapping requirements
rows.reason: suggestions/, decision-desk/, decision-hub/, nfl-command/, nfl-insights/, site/, root pages/ and skill-lab/ all publish suggestions/questions/injuries/leaderboards (I-04).
rows.action: Owner decision SG-01/SG-11: one canonical site + this hub as the triage layer; sibling labs become archives.

rows.item: Four different reward schedules for one competition
rows.reason: Root 3-tier, skill-lab 4-tier points, origination-lab pool-share, suggestions 3-tier - all unfunded (I-06).
rows.action: Adopt one (SG-04) and archive the rest.

rows.item: Mixed as-of dates across published numbers (2026-10-29 / 11-01 / 11-02 / 11-12)
rows.reason: Numbers computed on different data cuts appear side by side (I-07); live standings have moved since every snapshot.
rows.action: Stamp as-of on every value (SG-06) and align refresh cadence (SG-10).

rows.item: Carried flags from sibling registers still open (11 root + 12 skill-lab + 12 suggestions + 9 verification items)
rows.reason: Examples: injury page week-title mismatch (REG7), archived DraftKings rules edition 8.1.24 vs active 10.7.26, NOWData preliminary values, weather coverage ~57% (I-08).
rows.action: Triage in one pass using this hub's registers (SG-11); none block publication.
